address.title: Solarman logger
address.description: Enter the IP address and serial number of the Wi-Fi logger stick plugged into the inverter. The serial is on the stick's label and on its web page (Device serial number).

error.host: Please enter a valid IPv4 address.
error.serial: The logger serial number must contain digits only.
error.type: This inverter (device type __type__) is not a three-phase low-voltage hybrid (SG04LP3), which is the only model this app supports so far.
